title: Galariak Prime
extract:
Galariak Prime is a standalone Prime Scythe used by ancient Orokin Era  Grineer soldiers. Its Critical Chance increases for each individual Status Effect type on the target.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Gains a flat +10% Critical Chance bonus per unique Status Effect type on the target hit.
Valid status effects are  Impact,  Puncture,  Slash,  Heat,  Cold,  Electricity,  Toxin,  Radiation,  Gas,  Magnetic,  Viral,  Corrosive,  Void, and  Tau.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Stalking Fan stance.
Innate two  polarities.

Acquisition
Galariak Prime's main and component blueprints are obtained from Rotation A of The Perita Rebellion, available after completing The Old Peace quest.
Alternatively Galariak Prime's blueprints can be purchased from Roathe in La Cathėdrale, Sanctum Anatomica for  Maphica obtained in The Descendia. Each component blueprint requires 25 and the main blueprint requires 35, totaling 85 Maphica for the whole set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Crafting
Galariak Prime's materials are obtained from The Perita Rebellion. A total of 1100  Agnovidisc, 360  Laudavi, and 170  Servoris are needed to craft both parts.

Notes
The parts cannot be sold for  Orokin Ducats.
Both  Galariak Prime and  Sagek Prime only appear in Duviri AFTER obtaining the weapons. (Bug?)

Trivia
Anarch Grineer Trapper units use a miniature Galariak Prime as their melee weapon.
Despite having Prime in the name, Baro Ki'Teer will not interact with the player as he would if you had primes equipped.
